visualCharacteristics: A blue box with a heading and a grid of coloured speech bubbles; clicking a bubble opens a modal with its explanation.
contentPattern: Row 1: one cell with a heading and intro paragraph. Rows 2..n: one per bubble with [label paragraph][modal content: heading + paragraphs][colour keyword: red, ltblue or dkblue].
usage: Use it to present a set of life-event triggers as clickable bubbles that each open a detail modal.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it only for this bubble-and-modal guide; pick accordion or cards for ordinary expandable or listed content.
